title: 2020年7月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2020年7月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
prompt: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on the use of translation apps. You can start your essay with the sentence "The use of translation apps is becoming increasingly popular." You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: The use of translation apps is becoming increasingly popular. Whether traveling abroad, reading foreign documents, or chatting with friends from other countries, more and more people now reach for their phones instead of a dictionary. This growing trend deserves a closer look. On the one hand, these apps bring undeniable convenience, for they can translate a whole page in seconds, break down language barriers, and allow smooth communication across cultures. On the other hand, an over- reliance on them may weaken our motivation to learn foreign languages. If we let software do all the work, our own vocabulary and speaking ability may gradually fade. In my view, translation apps should be treated as a helpful tool rather than a substitute for real language skills. While we enjoy their efficiency, we ought to keep practicing and improving ourselves. Only in this way can technology truly serve us instead of controlling us.
keyPoints: 首句原样开场。开头 The use of translation apps is becoming increasingly popular. 一字 未改地照抄了给定首句，随后用 Whether traveling abroad... 排比出使用场景，末句 This growing trend deserves a closer look. 收束引出下文，落实了'照抄首句再铺背景'。

正反成对论证。本段以 On the one hand... On the other hand... 一正一反成对展开：先讲 translate a whole page in seconds、break down language barriers 的便利，再用 an over-reliance on them may weaken 点出隐忧，并以 If we let software do all the work 假设句推演后果，兑现了'正 反两手辩证论'。
表态并升华。以 In my view 亮出'a helpful tool rather than a substitute'的立场，用 While we enjoy their efficiency 让步给建议，末句 Only in this way can technology truly serve us 升华收 尾，完成'表态收束加升华'。
